name: Fedora
description: Community Linux distribution sponsored by Red Hat.
summary: Fedora permits AI-assisted contributions as long as the human contributor takes full responsibility for the work and its license compliance, and discloses AI use when a significant part of the contribution is taken from a tool unchanged. Routine help with grammar, spelling or clarity needs no disclosure.

evidence.quote: You MAY use AI assistance for contributing to Fedora, as long as you follow the principles described below.
Accountability: You MUST take the responsibility for your contribution. Contributing to Fedora means vouching for the quality, license compliance, and utility of your submission.

Transparency: You MUST disclose the use of AI tools when the significant part of the contribution is taken from a tool without changes. You SHOULD disclose the other uses of AI tools, where it might be useful.
